name: Капитан гарнизона
notes: Commander of the Kragmir army detachment at the deep mines fort, a generic type (one per map). The fort holds the known route to Ssir-Ket, homeland of the Пауки-Оборотни. The commander runs the garrison like a drill yard: orders before the first blow, a voice that keeps a falling soldier on his feet, and a dorn-dergar to hold the gate at reach. The garrison is a separate force from the mines guard and always fights to kill. Table note: Commanding Aura grants its temporary Hit Points through the linked effect; drag it onto each ally that starts its turn within 60 feet.

actions.name: Opening Orders
actions.text:
Trigger The captain rolls initiative and can see at least one enemy

Effect The captain unleashes a command to ready for combat. Each ally within 120 feet that can hear the captain can either Raise a Shield or Step as a free action when it rolls initiative.

actions.name: Advancing Orders
actions.text: The captain issues a command to push forward on the battlefield. Each ally who hears and understands this command becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Quickened] until the end of its next turn but can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.

actions.name: Chastising Enforcement
actions.text: The captain exhorts a faltering comrade with a stern word and attempts an @Check[intimidation|against:will] check against the Will DC of one ally within 30 feet. On a success, the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] condition is reduced by 2 and the captain can attempt to counteract one mental effect that ally is suffering from with a [[/r 1d20+20 #Counteract]]{+20} counteract modifier. On a critical success, the captain also reduces the frightened condition of each other ally in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] around the target by 1.

actions.name: Commanding Aura
actions.text:
60 feet. An ally that starts its turn in the aura gains 8 temporary Hit Points. These last until the start of the creature's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.Effect: Commanding Aura]

actions.name: You Don't Have My Permission to Die!
actions.text:
Trigger An allied creature within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect With a stern rebuke, the captain berates the target for their failure. The creature avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP. The creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

actions.name: Dwarven Doughtiness
actions.text: Dwarves are often calm and collected in the face of imminent danger. At the end of the captain's turn, reduce its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] condition by 2 instead of 1.
